title: Gateway slot claims and allocation maps have no resource bounds
description: P3 security review finding. The newly exported slot coordination types accept caller-controlled Vec sizes without protocol caps: SlotClaim::new accepts arbitrary slots, overlap_with/resolve_conflict perform O(n*m) contains scans and allocate an overlap Vec, find_next_available performs repeated linear contains, SlotAllocationMap accepts unlimited gateways and arbitrary per-gateway slot vectors, and assign_ordinals clones/sorts an unbounded slice. When wired to coordination messages this permits memory/CPU exhaustion by an authenticated or newly-TOFU peer. Define hard maxima from slots_per_superframe/federation policy, reject duplicates and out-of-range slots at decode/admission, bound peer/map counts, and use bounded/linear-time set representations. Add maximum+1 and large-overlap rejection tests.
